hook: Junk removal needs $62.36 an hour, not $25
hook_say: $60,000 a year over 2,400 hours looks like $25 an hour. Break-even is $62.36.

rows.label: Take-home pay you want
rows.why: The calculator's example goal: $60,000 a year of take-home pay.

rows.label: Hours you work
rows.why: 50 hours a week for 48 weeks, counting quoting, driving and admin.

rows.label: The usual guess
rows.say: So it feels like $25 an hour
rows.why: $60,000 divided by all 2,400 hours. The calculator flags this as the usual guess.

rows.label: Hours customers pay for
rows.say: But customers pay for 1,440 of those hours
rows.why: 60% of the hours you work are paid; the rest is quoting, driving and admin.

rows.label: Tax on your pay
rows.why: Self-employment tax of 15.3% on 92.35% of profit, plus a 12% income tax estimate.

rows.label: Insurance, ads and other costs
rows.why: $715 a month: insurance, phone, ads, dollies and tarps, trailer, fees, permits.

rows.label: Break-even per paid hour
rows.why: $89,803 of revenue needed over 1,440 paid hours.

fix.label: Rate with a 15% profit margin
fix.why: Break-even $62.36 with a 15% profit margin (15% of the price is profit): $73.37 per paid hour, the rate every quote starts from.

Example numbers from the Junk Removal Pricing Calculator; estimates, not tax advice.
